title: District-level REALTOR-board market statistics, Hawaii (Oahu, Maui County, Hawaii Island, Kauai)

periods.oahu_district: July 2026 month and YTD Jan-Jul 2026 vs Jan-Jul 2025 (HBR Local Market Update, latest district edition publicly posted; August 2026 LMU not found online as of 2026-10-08)
periods.oahu_islandwide_latest: August 2026 month and YTD Jan-Aug 2026 vs 2025 (HBR Monthly Stats Report). September 2026 HBR release not yet out (hicentral mpr-2026-09 returned 404).
periods.oahu_full_year_2025_district: Jan-Dec 2025 vs 2024 (HBR Local Market Update December 2025)
periods.maui: September 2026 month (with Aug 2026 and Sep 2025) and YTD Jan-Sep 2026 vs Jan-Sep 2025 (RAM monthly report, current as of 2026-10-01)
periods.hawaii_island_ytd: YTD Jan 1-May 31 2026 vs same period 2025 (Fidelity National Title summary of Hawaii Information Service MLS data; latest district YTD edition found)
periods.hawaii_island_monthly: August 2026 and September 2026 single months by tax district (Title Guaranty Residential Sales Report)
periods.kauai_ytd: YTD Jan 1-Apr 30 2026 vs same period 2025 (Fidelity National Title summary sourced to Kauai Board of REALTORS; latest district YTD edition found)
periods.kauai_monthly: August 2026 and September 2026 single months by tax district (Title Guaranty Residential Sales Report)
periods.kauai_ytd_aug_regions: YTD Jan-Aug 2026 vs Jan-Aug 2025 broad regions (Hawaii Life agent market update posts citing Kauai MLS data)

metric_definitions.closed_sales: Count of MLS resale transactions that closed in the period (HBR: residential resales on HiCentral MLS; RAM: closed sales on RAM MLS; HIS/KBOR: recorded MLS sales).
metric_definitions.median_sales_price: Median closed price of the closed sales in the period, USD. Medians of sub-areas cannot be combined; Upcountry Maui is shown as summed counts/volume only.
metric_definitions.ytd_median: Median of all closings from Jan 1 to end of the reported month (not an average of monthly medians).
metric_definitions.chg_pct_rounded: Percent change as printed in source (HBR LMU rounds to whole percent).
metric_definitions.pct_orig_list_price_received: Median of sold price / original list price (HBR).
metric_definitions.hbr_tmk_area: HBR Local Market Update "local market" defined by Tax Map Key zones (e.g., Kapahulu - Diamond Head = TMK 1-3-1 to 1-3-4).
metric_definitions.hbr_mls_region: HiCentral MLS region grouping used in HBR Neighborhoods Summary (Central, Diamond Head, Ewa Plain, Hawaii Kai, Kailua, Kaneohe, Leeward, Makakilo, Metro, North Shore, Pearl City, Waipahu). Differs from TMK areas.
metric_definitions.ram_area: REALTORS Association of Maui MLS area. "All MLS" = Maui County total incl. Lanai and Molokai.
metric_definitions.tg_rounded: Title Guaranty prints dollar volume and medians rounded to $0.1M / $0.1K; arrows show direction vs same month last year only.

oahu.source_note: Honolulu Board of REALTORS (HBR), residential resales compiled from HiCentral MLS.

maui_county.source_note: REALTORS Association of Maui (RAM) monthly market report, data current as of 2026-10-01, report by ShowingTime Plus.

hawaii_island.source_note: District YTD: Fidelity National Title (FidelityHawaii.com) "Big Island May 2026" summary, "All information taken from Hawaii Information Services" MLS sales data. Monthly: Title Guaranty Residential Sales Report (Hawaii), Aug and Sep 2026.

kauai.source_note: District YTD: Fidelity National Title "Kauai Stats April 2026" summary, source Kauai Board of REALTORS. Monthly: Title Guaranty Residential Sales Report (Kauai), Aug and Sep 2026. YTD-Aug regions: Hawaii Life Kauai market update posts (agent analysis of MLS data).

gaps: Oahu: August 2026 HBR Local Market Update (district/TMK and neighborhood tables) not posted publicly as of 2026-10-08 (oahure.com 08-2026-Aug-B-LMU.pdf 404; HBR Aug Drive folder contains only the islandwide MSR). District figures are therefore July 2026 / YTD Jan-Jul; islandwide figures are August 2026 / YTD Jan-Aug. September 2026 HBR release not yet published (hicentral mpr-2026-09 404 earlier today).

Oahu: HBR has no "Kapolei" TMK area or MLS region; Kapolei neighborhoods sit in Ewa Plain (TMK 1-9-1 / Ewa Plain MLS region). Only summed sale counts are given for KAPOLEI* neighborhoods; no combined median.

Hawaii Island: Hawaii Island REALTORS (hawaiiislandrealtors.org) and Hawaii Information Service (hawaiiinformation.com) returned bot-challenge pages (not bypassed). Latest district YTD found = Fidelity summary of HIS data through May 31 2026; Aug/Sep 2026 district data only as single-month Title Guaranty counts/rounded medians. "Waimea" is not a separate HIS tax district (split South Kohala/Hamakua) - no separate figures.

Kauai: Kauai Board of REALTORS site (kauaiboard.com) returned a bot-challenge page (kbor.org is an unrelated site). Latest district YTD = Fidelity summary of KBOR data through Apr 30 2026; Aug/Sep 2026 district data only as Title Guaranty single-month counts/rounded medians; Hawaii Life gives YTD-Aug medians for North Shore, South Shore and Lihue only (Kapaa/East and West Side medians not reported). Kalaheo is inside Koloa tax district; Poipu not broken out separately.
Maui: RAM areas have no combined "Upcountry" line; Upcountry = Kula/Ulupalakua/Kanaio + Makawao/Olinda/Haliimaile + Pukalani shown as summed units/volume and derived average only (no median).

Price tiers: district-level reports do not publish price-bracket counts, so standard tiers (entry<750K, mid 750K-1.5M, upper 1.5-3M, luxury 3-10M, ultra>=10M) cannot be computed by district. Oahu islandwide tier counts are derived from HBR brackets where boundaries align ($1M, $1.5M, $3M for SF; $1M, $1.5M, $2M for condos); the $750K boundary falls inside HBR 700-799K (SF) / 700-999K (condo) brackets, so entry/mid are given as [lower, upper] bounds; 3-10M vs 10M+ cannot be split (HBR top SF bracket is $3M+). $5M+ counts not available from board reports.
Title Guaranty "YTD TREND" bar charts on its regional page are unlabeled by year and were NOT used.
caveats: Small samples: many district/month cells have 1-10 sales; medians swing widely. Prefer YTD figures.

Sources use different geographies: HBR TMK areas vs HBR MLS regions vs RAM MLS areas vs HIS/KBOR tax districts vs Title Guaranty tax districts vs Hawaii Life MLS regions. Do not mix within a comparison.
Fidelity/Title Guaranty are title-company republications of board/MLS data, not the boards themselves; Hawaii Life figures are an agent's MLS pull.
HBR percent changes in LMU are rounded to whole percent; neighborhood table percent changes have one decimal.
No owner names or street addresses are included; building/subdivision names appear only as HBR neighborhood labels.

validation.oahu_tmk_sum_equals_islandwide: Sum of 21 TMK-area YTD Jan-Jul 2026 closed sales = 1,686 SF and 2,469 condo, equal to LMU islandwide page; MLS region totals also sum to 1,686 / 2,469; Jul month TMK sums = 300 SF / 416 condo (= HBR July release).
validation.maui_area_sum_equals_all_mls: Sum of 25 RAM areas YTD Sep 2026 = 537 SF and 620 condo = "All MLS" row = overview page.
validation.hawaii_island_and_kauai_district_sums: District unit counts sum to the TOTAL row for residential, condo and land in both Fidelity summaries (asserted in parser).
validation.tg_kauai_sep_2026: TG Kauai Sep 2026 district SF counts (0+7+1+9+1=18) and condo counts (2+1+1+2=6) equal the island totals printed on TG page 1.
